proof_0193.moves: Commute the product a * b into b * a, then apply the already-proved cancellation b * a / a = b (using a ≠ 0). Two steps: commutativity plus the right-cancellation lemma.

proof_0194.moves: To identify a composite involving the inverse of colimit.pre, move the inverse to the other side (comp_inv_eq for an isomorphism) and then close with the defining compatibility ι ≫ pre = ι. The rest is simp bookkeeping.

proof_0195.moves: Split the iff and hand each direction to an existing lemma: pushing a face forward along an injective linear map (IsFaceOf.map), and pulling one back (of_map_injective). The only structural move is Iff.intro.

proof_0196.moves: The whole proof is the symmetric form of the already-proved statement that a cast nonnegative rational commutes with any element: apply cast_commute and flip it with Commute.symm.

proof_0197.moves: Destructure the divisibility hypothesis into an explicit witness (k ∣ n gives n = k * c), substitute it, and then the goal is exactly the gcd lemma for an added left multiple, up to a symm. The real content is exhibiting the witness and rewriting.

proof_0198.moves: Induction on the iteration count: iterating x ↦ x^n zero times is the identity, and one more iteration multiplies the exponent by n again. The content is the induction plus the exponent-law step, packaged here as a structural recursion.

proof_0199.moves: Unfold toBitVec32 as a cast of toBitVec, push the already-known mod compatibility for toBitVec through, and use congruence for BitVec.cast to match the widths. Mostly a rewriting/congruence chain over one real lemma.

proof_0200.moves: A normalization restatement: turn the Bool-valued equality (x + y == x + z) into a propositional iff (beq_iff_eq / Bool.eq_iff_iff), apply left-cancellation for BitVec addition, then close by reflexivity. The rest is simp/propext residue.

proof_0201.moves: Truncating and clamping agree on the relevant range, so the statement is exactly the already-proved clamp version; the proof is a single application.

proof_0202.moves: Conjugation of an automorphism by an isomorphism is α.symm ≫≥ f ≫≥ α by construction; reduce equality of automorphisms to equality of their underlying homs (Aut.ext) and then it holds definitionally.

proof_0203.moves: A simp-lemma unfolding the action of the coalgebra-to-over-object functor on morphisms; it holds by definition, so the proof is reflexivity. No mathematical step beyond unfolding the construction.

proof_0204.moves: Projection lemma reading off the unit-comparison morphism η of the monoidal structure on the inverse of the mop-mop equivalence; true by definition, proved by rfl.

proof_0205.moves: Unfold toBitVec64 as a cast, apply the known description of Int64.toISize on bit vectors (sign extension to the platform width), and reconcile the widths with a cast congruence. A rewriting chain over one real lemma.

proof_0206.moves: Split the iff: forward direction is the transport of limits in the opposite category to colimits, backward direction is already available as an instance so typeclass search closes it.

proof_0207.moves: Projection lemma: the hom component of an isomorphism of frames built from an order isomorphism is the underlying order map; definitional, proved by rfl.

proof_0208.moves: Use that a < b is a + 1 ≤ b over the integers, so the strict version of 'less than a min' is exactly the non-strict lemma applied at a + 1.

proof_0209.moves: Pattern-match to destruct both IsNat hypotheses (so the ordinals become casts of naturals), then the goal is the compatibility of the cast with multiplication, flipped by symm and repackaged as IsNat.

proof_0210.moves: Mechanically derived reassociated form of coprod.inl ≫≥ fst = ...: whisker the base lemma with an arbitrary further morphism and reassociate the composites (and cancel an identity).

proof_0211.moves: Reads off the face map of a whiskered simplicial object as the whiskering applied to the face map; true by definition, closed by rfl.

proof_0212.moves: The underlying functor morphism of the identity morphism of a lax monoidal functor is the identity; holds by definition of the category structure, proved by rfl.

proof_0213.moves: Specialize the general statement (that the cocone maps into a colimit in Type are jointly surjective) from an abstract IsColimit witness to the chosen colimit cocone; a single application.

proof_0214.moves: Projection lemma naming the counit isomorphism of the equivalence of discrete categories induced by an equivalence of types; definitional, closed by rfl.

proof_0215.moves: Reads off the h₂ component of the symmetric of a homotopy (it is the negative / the same map transported); holds by definition of Homotopy.symm, so rfl.

proof_0216.moves: The universal map out of a direct limit of rings, precomposed with the canonical map from a stage, is the given compatible family member; this is definitional for the lift construction, so rfl.
